query.text: 请帮我看着路，我牵导盲犬走路时如果前方有障碍物或危险，请及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please watch the road for me and alert me immediately if there are any obstacles or dangers ahead while I'm walking with my guide dog.

annotation.text_zh: 前方停有一辆电动车，导盲犬已带您停下。
annotation.text_en: There's an electric scooter parked ahead, and your guide dog has stopped you.
